name: bmad-module-ultracode-goal-stack
description: Stack skill for bmad-module-ultracode-goal — 7 libraries with 9 integration patterns, composed from tag-pinned skills for BMAD Method v6.12.0 (the installer and BMM skills), BMad Builder v2.2.2, TEA v1.27.2, graphify v0.9.92 and IWE 0.28.0, plus the docs-only Claude Code skill (pin v2.1.283, recorded for reference). Use when reasoning about how the installer discovers, configures and registers BMM, BMad Builder and TEA, where TEA's ATDD sits in the BMM story cycle, how deprecated v6 IDs flow through shims, how installed skills and TEA's enforcement hook land in Claude Code's .claude/ folder, or how graphify's Claude Code install and the IWE plugin's hooks share Claude Code's hook layer with TEA. NOT for individual library usage outside this project's conventions.
compatibility: bmad-method 6.12.0; bmad-builder 2.2.2; tea 1.27.2; claude-code 2.1.283; graphify 0.9.92; iwe 0.28.0
